annotations.title: Prep for a Day of Client Meetings

description: Returns a prep briefing for each of a day's client meetings in one call. Input is a list of meetings (client description, optional topic, optional time). Each briefing has the matched topic, two key terms, a sourced opening fact, and a risk-alignment summary if a risk tolerance was given. It does not access any calendar; the advisor supplies the meetings.

client_description.description: Client background, interests, or context for this meeting

time.description: Optional meeting time, for display/ordering only

name: advisor.daily_prep
